'''Business and economy'''
*The [[First Takaichi cabinet|Takaichi Cabinet]] of [[Japan]] approves a [[Japanese yen|¥]]122.3 trillion (US$785 billion) budget for the next fiscal year, the largest [[national budget]] in Japan's history, while reducing the [[National debt of Japan|debt]]-dependence ratio to 24.2 percent, supported by projected [[Taxation in Japan|tax revenues]] of a record ¥83.7 trillion ($535 billion). [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japans-cabinet-approves-record-785-billion-budget-vows-keep-debt-check-2025-12-26/ (Reuters)]
